Q6064.reason: A lease binds the owner's successor and does not end at the landlord's death, so A's premise is wrong. If the tenant believed the lease still ran, he acknowledged the owner's title and his possession was not hostile, so adverse possession fails.

Q8442.reason: Austin drew the line between general and particular jurisprudence in The Province of Jurisprudence Determined, before Holland wrote The Elements of Jurisprudence.
